brief: Holds one Unicode char and answers questions about it: its codepoint, name, script, case, bidi class and category.
detail: Reach for it when a single char deserves more than a one-char stzString. It wraps a stzString and answers from the engine's Unicode data. It is built from a one-char text, a codepoint number, a hex form such as U+0061 or a Unicode char name. A method not defined here falls through to stzString, so a char also answers text questions.
